description: The main window: hear the machine's events (listen, unlisten). Nothing else from core: no menus, trays, paths, images or emitting. The app's own commands (`command`, `set_theme`, `emulator_rom*`, `serial_*`, `folder_*`, `save_file`, `mcp_*`) are allowed by default; dialogs open from Rust, and the serial bytes come on the channel the page passes to serial_open.
